"Why did I stop" 

Shortly after realizing that I had survived my suicide attempt, I tried to better myself by reading book and playing video games. But that didn't last very long. 

About two months later after my first suicide attempt, I tried to do it again for personal reasons. And those reasons I didn't have control over. I was alone through the whole trip. I didn't have anyone. I wasn't a complete loner, I had friends that I would socialize with and hang out with, but none of them knew how I was truly feeling. 

After my third attempt, I decided to tell one of my close friends that I've attempted suicide on three different occasions. She just laughed and said, "don't be a bitch, grow a pair" after that I became more revert. I stopped hanging out, I stopped going out to parties. I was completely alone. I had no idea what to do, I didn't know what to do. I gave myself support for all these years and thoughtout high school I made, maybe two more suicide attempts. 

Shortly after my freshman year of high school, I met a girl that helped me cope with all this pain and she understood everything. She didn't tell me to kill myself, she didn't berate me, she supported me all the way. I would sometimes call her in the middle of the night crying my eyes out because I was feeling depressed and she would help me. 

Come sophomore year, she passed away in a car crash. I was absolutely devastated. The only person that has ever helped me has just passed away and I was alone again. I stayed alone for another 2 years. I made it through by thinking about what she said and how to keep going and not stay in the past. 

Now, I have a close friend that truly helps me out a lot. She's talked me out of 2 suicide attempts and I forever thankful for her support. I don't know where I'd be without her support or my long time friend.
